title: AgentCheckout Off-Platform: agentic-checkout integration and assurance for custom storefronts

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: The gap for off-platform merchants is adequately evidenced (Salesforce's own guidance names custom/headless as the exception; WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and commercetools merchants self-serve), and protocol churn creates repeat work; no buyer-side frequency evidence, so 3.

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Buyer assumed (custom/headless merchants and their small agencies); the sources establish the gap, not a budget, and vendor-quoted integration ranges are unverified marketing. Capped at 2.

evidence_strength.rationale: Adequately evidenced for this market: platform developer documentation (Salesforce UCP GA in B2C Commerce 26.9), the Shopify `ucp-proxy` repository, a protocol/timeline account and several credible vendor/agency secondary sources; no primary buyer-side evidence.

differentiation.rationale: No defensible wedge: hosted UCP hubs, commerce-platform middleware, platform-native support and an open-source Shopify proxy already serve the position, and general middleware vendors operate it as a managed service. Direct incumbents contest the wedge, so capped at 2.

economics.rationale: Services-heavy delivery with continuous spec maintenance; the cited vendor material itself says merchants below roughly USD 1.5m GMV should defer to the platform, removing the small end. Modelled economics on untested inputs capped at 2.

economic_buyer.note: Buyer assumed (custom/headless merchants and their small agencies); the sources establish the gap, not a budget.
economic_buyer.resolve_via: Ask 3 agencies what they charge and whether merchants buy.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: No buyer-specific frequency or budget evidence; vendor-quoted integration ranges are unverified marketing.
painful_frequent_or_budgeted.resolve_via: Buyer interviews plus review of agency delivery spend.

non_paid_distribution.note: Agency partnerships and developer content are plausible; no prospects or channel identified.
non_paid_distribution.resolve_via: One agency-partnership or content launch measured for qualified inbound.

defensible_wedge.note: Hosted UCP hubs, commerce-platform middleware, platform-native support, an open-source Shopify proxy and general middleware vendors already sell this exact position; the wedge is a feature of the commerce-integration/platform category.

no_network_effects_needed.note: A single-merchant integration may be useful alone, but assurance value may scale with conformance data across merchants.
no_network_effects_needed.resolve_via: Confirm utility for a single merchant.

plausible_margins.note: Services-heavy delivery with continuous spec maintenance; the small end of the market is explicitly discouraged by protocol vendors.
plausible_margins.resolve_via: Model 10 integrations over two spec cycles.

acceptable_risk.note: Payment/checkout integration carries security and platform-compliance exposure.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: A zero-cost desk competitive scan was sufficient to disconfirm the wedge this run.

not_all_optimistic.note: Viability rests on several untested assumptions (buyer, price, recurrence).
not_all_optimistic.resolve_via: Name and test the weakest assumption first.
